sections.shortTitle: Removal From Service Special Powers Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Substitution of section 9, Ordinance XVIII of 2000

REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
REMOVAL FROM
SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 23rd July, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 23‑7‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
2. Substitution of section 9,
Ordinance XVIII of 2000.‑‑‑In the Removal from Service
(Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 (XVII of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the
said Ordinance, for section 9 the following shall be substituted; namely:
"(9) Representation
‑‑‑(1) A person on whom a penalty is imposed under
section 3, may, within fifteen days from the date of communication of the order
prefer a representation to the Chief Executive or such officer or authority as
the Chief Executive may designate:
Provided that where the order has
been made by the Chief Executive such person may, within the aforesaid period,
submit a representation to the President.
(2) The President, the Chief
Executive, or an officer or authority, as may be designate for the purpose by
the Chief Executive, may, on consideration of the representation, and any other
relevant material, confirm, set aside, vary or modify the order in respect of
which such representation is made. "
